Agent 27/35 — Showcase Circuit tightest-corner handling feasibility. Use the track QA tightest radius (~32.6m, ~61 km/h at 0.90g) and the new digital steering controller to simulate realistic entry, apex and exit. Determine whether keyboard/touch can trace the corner without tire saturation, excessive speed scrub or understeer. Tune only driver input shaping if needed; do not modify track geometry or add grip. Produce telemetry-based acceptance criteria.
